Trakt is an international movie and TV tracking platform, similar to Douban's marking feature. You can record movies and shows you want to watch or have watched, track viewing progress, and get personalized recommendations.

After logging in to Trakt in this app, you can:
• Sync and manage your watchlist/watched list
• Import marks from Douban to Trakt in one tap
• Sync your viewing records across devices
• View watching statistics and recommendations

If you don't have a Trakt account yet, tap the button below to register.
This page is used to log in to Douban to read your public marks (wishlist/watched). Credentials are used only for this sync and are not uploaded to any third-party server.

• Why login: to read your Douban marks (wishlist, watched, ratings)
• What is stored: only Cookie and userId (for this crawl), NOT your Douban password
• Cookie usage: only for requesting movie.douban.com/people/{userId}/wish|collect pages
• After sync: you can clear Douban credentials anytime in Settings
• Data flow: Douban → App; when Trakt is connected, marks can also sync to Trakt

pansou_template: compatible with the PanSou API response format. The resource list is under the data.merged_by_type field, a map keyed by disk type (quark/baidu/aliyun/xunlei/uc/115/magnet) with an array of links as the value; each link has note (name, may be empty), url and datetime fields.

zreso_template: compatible with the ZReso API response format. The resource list is under the data.results field, an array; each element has title (name), datetime/date and links (an array, the first link\'s url and type are used).
custom: custom mode, requires JSONPath expressions (e.g. $.data.results) to parse JSON response yourself.

If API returns JSON: {"data": {"results": [{"title": "Movie Name", "url": "https://...", "type": "quark"}]}}
Config: parseMode = custom listPath = $.data.results namePath = $.title urlPath = $.url diskTypePath = $.type

Douban and Trakt statuses may diverge. The check unifies both sides by the rule "Watched takes priority over Want-to-watch": the watched status overrides wishlist, and the side that is watched is written back to the other, so no mark is ever lost. It also cleans up legacy items that are both in Want-to-watch and Watched on Trakt (leftover from old data), automatically removing their Want-to-watch mark. Q: What do the numbers above mean?\nA: They combine Trakt watch history with Douban watched marks, de-duplicated across both sources by IMDb / Trakt / TMDB id (falling back to title + year), so the same title is never counted twice. Movies count distinct titles — replays are not counted again. Shows use two figures: the big number is shows you watched at least one episode of, and the line below is shows you finished (watched episodes ≥ aired episodes). Douban has no per-episode detail for shows, so a Douban “watched” mark counts as finished, and the cached episode count is added to watched episodes.
Q: What is the watching heatmap?\nA: Similar to GitHub\'s contribution graph, each square represents one day. The darker the color, the more you watched that day. It covers the past year.
Q: What is the genre distribution pie chart?\nA: It shows genres from your Trakt history and Douban watched titles. Tap a slice to see the exact count and percentage.
Q: What is the top genres ranking?\nA: Your most-watched genres ranked by count. The top three are marked with gold, silver, and bronze medals.
Q: How is watch time calculated?\nA: It combines Trakt watch time with cached Douban movie runtimes and Douban show episode count × episode runtime. Missing cached details are not estimated.
Q: What are rating statistics?\nA: Shows ratings from Trakt and Douban, including the total, average, and distribution. Douban 1-5 star ratings are converted to the 10-point scale.

TraktoSearch has no ads or analytics SDKs. Watch history, lists and progress are processed on your device first. A request leaves the device only when a feature needs it, such as sign-in, sync, title lookup, resource search, AI roast, weather, crash reporting or feedback.

Activation: Android ID is used for device binding, not advertising tracking
On device: credentials and tokens use EncryptedSharedPreferences backed by Android Keystore; lists, sync records, ratings and progress use a SQLCipher-encrypted database
Network requests: HTTPS and gateway JWT authentication relay upstream requests; the client never carries Worker Secrets
Server: protected cloud sync data and credentials are encrypted by the Worker with server-side secrets; those keys are never shipped in the APK

TraktoSearch is an independently developed Android tool, not a movie platform, cloud drive or content distribution service. Use third-party accounts and returned links within their terms and your local law. This page explains the project\'s boundaries; it is not legal advice.
Independent project, not affiliated with third parties

TraktoSearch is not affiliated with, operated by or officially endorsed by Douban, Trakt, TMDB, OMDb, PanSou, PanHub, ZReso, any cloud-drive service, GitHub or the Chiikawa rights holders. Service names and trademarks identify compatibility targets only; third-party data may be incomplete, inaccurate or unavailable.

These actions start only when you request them and remain subject to Douban permissions, access rules, captchas and API changes. Use your own account only. Do not bypass access controls, scrape in bulk, overload services or collect other people\'s data.

Search sources and cloud-drive handling only query or open links returned by third parties; this app does not upload, host, cache or distribute movie files, and gives no guarantee about the content or authorization status behind any link. Verify content licensing and the laws of your region yourself.

Movie metadata may come from TMDB: This product uses TMDB and the TMDB APIs but is not endorsed, certified, or otherwise approved by TMDB. Watch history and sync are subject to Trakt\'s terms of service.

Original code is licensed under GNU GPLv3; movie metadata, third-party API content, dependencies, posters and character assets are not automatically licensed under GPLv3 by the open-sourcing of the code.
Access, correct or delete your data

You can change local controls in Settings, revoke location permission in Android settings, clear local cache or credentials where the app provides that action, and submit access, correction, deletion or copyright requests through the rights form. The form collects only what is needed to process the request; closed requests are retained for no more than 180 days.
